cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) with one prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4), no prominent reinforcing route. E3 point Parfum (12). Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3) hydrotrope and Cocamide MEA (9) foam booster are not routes (C3). TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (17) is a strong sulfonate after Parfum, recorded only (C4) and a counter-signal toward strong. Neighbor strong.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful silicone/guar system - early Dimethiconol (7, prominent), Dimethicone (13), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (14) - with pearlizing Glycol Distearate (10). C2 is not met because the humectant element is absent in substance: only trace glycols (Butylene Glycol 23, Triethylene/Propylene Glycol 31-32) and Aloe juice (24), no glycerin/panthenol. Counter-signal: early silicone + guar + pearlizer is close to C2 -> neighbor high.

depositionLoad.rationale: Prominent dimethiconol plus a second silicone and cationic guar: a real coacervate deposition system.

persistence.rationale: Silicones are persistent and can accumulate; no lipid/film reinforcement.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES with one betaine buffer, plus a late sulfonate; effective ordinary reset.

weightPotential.counterEvidence: No W-RICH (no payload lipid), only one cationic polymer, sulfate reset. W1 (silicone/guar on a buffered sulfate chassis) points to moderate.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone/guar system with an early silicone gives noticeable but bounded residue; sulfate reset bounds it.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no rich architecture and no third converging persistent family; W1 conditions (buffered C1 sulfate chassis at moderate, silicone/guar set, no further converging family) hold for this subset. Not low: two deposition families incl. a prominent silicone - W2 offers no basis to call the combined residue below noticeable.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Silicone level unknown; prominent dimethiconol makes the heavier neighbor realistic.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate (depositionLoad moderate, persistence moderate, resetCapacity moderate); neighbor high because the silicone is prominent.
weightPotential.selfCheck: Fingerprint matches; blind formula judgment; no count/position assigned band; three subjudgments present; W2 reasoning specific; no in-lane comparison.

No competing lengths-care role in the name (F7 not decisive).

usageRole.rationale: Treatment: dandruffSupport supported and a qualifying E2 dandruff claim unit graded moderate (U3). Wins over other triggers by U1 (none others fire: no U2 wording, not strong).
usageRole.decisionTrace: default regular; occasional_reset no; treatment fires; alternating/frequent not fired.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: explicit sensitive positioning exists (manufacturer 'gegen Kopfhautjucken', 'Sofortige Linderung juckender Kopfhaut', 'zur Beruhigung ... der Kopfhautbarriere'; SC1), but the complete formula lacks a credible supportive comfort architecture: SLES/betaine chassis with late DDBS, Menthol (16) cooling agent, Parfum and multiple allergens, no panthenol/allantoin/bisabolol or other listed comfort route, humectants only trace glycols/aloe. The anti-itch claim rests on the anti-dandruff active. Menthol is not a veto, but here nothing offsets it.
